tagline.en_US: A monitoring and alerting platform with a web console and agentless collection. The official one-image quick start includes its default H2 metadata store; persist /opt/hertzbeat/data and /opt/hertzbeat/logs.

description.en_US: Apache HertzBeat is an open-source real-time observability and monitoring platform. It integrates metrics and logs collection, analysis, alerting, and notifications into a single system without requiring host agents. The platform supports monitoring services, databases, operating systems, and networks through configurable protocols, and includes built-in tools for creating service status pages.
